STEP 5. Check the harness wire between the ABS-ECU 
connector A-02 and the stoplight switch connector C-03.
NOTE: After inspecting the intermediate connector C-06, 
inspect the wire. If the intermediate connector C-06 is 
damaged, repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. If the connector has been 
repaired or replaced, go to Step 7.
Q: Is the harness wire between the ABS-ECU connector A-
02 and the stoplight switch connector C-03 damaged?
YES : Repair it and then go to Step 7.
NO : No action is to be taken.
